name: snarl-sopi-backend
description: Snarl and Sopi operator backend v6.39.1: two fixes around tare-all, which already existed. The button is on a fridge's Controls tab under scales and sensors, and answering yes to 'is this machine completely EMPTY' already sends tare_all with force true - the backend has validated that parameter since the scale work. What was wrong is why it can be invisible: showMdTab decided whether to show the fridge-only panels by reading the model out of DB.machines, the browser's local copy, because the detail endpoint returns the raw machine record with no computed isFridge. A stale local copy, a machine added since the last hydrate, or a fresh browser meant the scales and lighting panels simply never appeared on a real fridge with nothing explaining why. It now uses the model from the detail response and falls back to the local copy only before that lands. Second, the tare-all prompt was a single confirm where Cancel meant 'not empty' and still sent a tare, so anyone who opened it and changed their mind, or pressed Escape, fired a command at the machine. It is now two steps and the first one aborts. Verified in a browser with the local copy of the machine deleted: panel and button appear, aborting sends nothing, and confirming both sends tare_all force true. Note a machine whose model is not set to GR-* is not a fridge to the backend, so it gets no fridge config block, no baskets and no scale panel - setting the model is what fixes all three at once. Cumulative over v6.39.0.
